meaning: Ca is no longer picked from a fixed grid: the search walks outward from M3's default by CA_STEP until it brackets the measured pulse amplitude, then bisects in log space (geometric midpoint), because Ca varies over decades. Non-bracketing is reported as a genuine "no compliance reproduces this amplitude" outcome rather than being silently rounded to a grid edge.

could_move.what: Fitted Ca_v for patient 083 changes: the header value 2.2556e-5 with 11.882 mmHg stage-B error was a grid edge, so bisection should either lower that error or report failure to bracket instead.
Amplitude-based plots and any M5 pulse traces shift for every M5 deck, since Ca sets the amplitude being matched.
Cross-model comparisons against M1 and M4 move, because only the M5 side is refitted.

expectation: For 083 the recorded 11.882 mmHg stage-B error should drop substantially, or the case should be declared non-bracketing. Direction for 081, 137, 150 is unknown from this context. CA_STEP and the bracket limit now decide how far out the walk goes, so results depend on them.

check.why: Re-solves the single patient whose Ca was a grid edge and reports the stage-B amplitude error, so the bracket-and-bisect result can be compared to the 11.882 mmHg in the header without refitting the whole cohort.
